args.subject: Marrow Agrisupply handover
args.body:
Hi Tobias,

Handover note for Marrow Agrisupply. The first two items come from the 9 June thread in #central-team and the third from Moss's Central handoffs digest dated 2 Jan 2026. I haven't found anything newer, so please check current status before relying on any of it.

- Eastbank door-label mismatch (ticket PD-4821): the receiving-door import attached to the ticket labels the doors E1/E2, but Marrow's booking sheet uses 01/02. Don't reimport until the labels are reconciled, or it will create duplicates. Hollis was handling setup/support on this.

- Pine Crossing missing afternoon shift: the morning receiver says the appointment screen shows only the afternoon shift. A driver arrived at 7:10 and the trailer number was written on a sticky note. Hollis was going to check the shift template and ask support to reproduce it with the store login. No ticket number was posted for this one. Pree was getting a screenshot of the missing shift and the exact door they were trying to book.

- Feature request FR-882: Marrow Agrisupply asked for custom pallet-jack icons on the Pemberline Dock yard map for their seasonal fertilizer sheds. Support routed it to the product backlog for Q2 review (per the January digest). I don't know its current status.

General rule from the thread: no store gets called "ready" until someone has opened the calendar and made a test booking.

I can't see whether the Eastbank or Pine Crossing issues have been resolved since June.
